hero.title: Building Your Vision, One Foundation at a Time

home.aboutPreview: PC Chauke Construction and Projects CC is a trusted building and renovation contractor, delivering quality workmanship across all provinces of South Africa — from small repairs to complete new builds.

body: PC Chauke Construction and Projects CC is a building and renovation contractor serving clients in every province of South Africa. From new builds to renovations and repairs, we deliver quality workmanship on every project, big or small.
We take on the full scope of a build — planning, structural work, finishes, and handover — so you have one accountable team from start to finish.
With a focus on honest pricing, reliable timelines and work that lasts, we deliver results our clients can trust.

team.name: PC Chauke
team.bio: PC Chauke is the founder of PC Chauke Construction and Projects CC, with nineteen years of hands-on experience in residential, commercial and industrial builds across South Africa. PC leads every project with the same standard he built his reputation on: quality workmanship, honest pricing, and delivery on time.
